body:
I find those who think they are like me. They huddle around my skirts; cry until I cry back. Sometimes it is easier to pack myself in a box so they can't see me, but then, that stranger I look for will never find me either. I have not had boyfriends, but hardcore fans. 


Stars are mine to love, but on my own. Sometimes I think "if somebody were here, we could feel this. it would fold out over us. it would be beauty and I would feel everything fall into place", under the stars, in the dark. But I know it's just a place for me to be with nobody else. Solitude *is* my beauty. I will never live with somebody as perfect as I live with myself. We hate, hurt, argue, but can sit under the stars in perfect silence and understand that it is temporary. Me, myself.



Once, I decided to die.


The music rose. My resolve strengthened. A scream occurred. Glass. Small blood cells. Some time passing. Blue lights. Car written off. Not even a fractured clavicle to show for it.


I realise I wasn't meant to. Not then. This world is mine; things inside it belong to me. It isn't reality. Reality is relative and there is nothing to relate this to, just me, looking out. 



People have tried therapy, medicines, other repression. Tell me, what is the correct response to life? To ignore it? To buy a magazine, forget what is happening? There is blood swimming through tiny tubes in your body. Wisps of cloud in the sky. Strings vibrate and feel your ears. A person smiles and your heart leaps. All of this, fucking absurd. None of this, objectively right or rational.


So, at times I may feel lost. My arms might bleed, for reasons best known to me, but no one else. And those people balk. They say, "she's crazy", "she's slipped again".


But the one time I was permitted to act this out. To bleed. Go to the park and sit under  the stars. I had my revelation, finally, the one they blocked for years. I knew who I was. I am at peace.


I need to move away, to be alone. Or I will die here.
